''See also: [[Timaias Adama Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Timaias Adama, also known as Adama, was a [[Sage]] who spent nearly three months as a guest at the Heaven’s Glory School{{!}}Heaven's Glory School. He possessed a Steelborn body{{!}}Steelborn Iron body and utilized swordplay in combat. Despite being perceived by the students of the school as a [[Gold]], he held the higher rank of [[Sage]]. During a confrontation with several [[Jades]] armed with makeshift clubs, Adama was injured by physical strikes and [[madra]]. He ultimately sacrificed his life for [[Yerin]], resulting in her inheriting his [[Remnant]]. His legacy is tied to the development of specific techniques, such as the [[Blood Shadow]], and it is suggested that a successor would only truly manifest their connection to him upon reaching the rank of [[Archlord]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Timaias Adama possesses an [[Archlord]] body alongside a Steelborn body{{!}}Steelborn Iron body. His physical form is further characterized by flesh infused with [[soulfire]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Adama demonstrated extreme selflessness by giving his life for [[Yerin]]. He also showed a protective nature, as he would not have permitted the development of [[Yerin's Blood Shadow]] to its present state.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Known as the [[Sage of the Endless Sword]], he carries the title of [[Sword Sage]]. He utilizes a [[wintersteel]] blade and maintains a [[void space]] containing experimental materials and ancient research notes.}}
